suggestions.title: The Greatest Blessing Is Peaceful Sleep
suggestions.hook: 9 लोगों का परिवार, कमाने वाला सिर्फ मैं
suggestions.reason: An emotional moment. The only earner in a family of nine is too ashamed to explain his problems and is told 'don't worry.' Ever since, he has never lost a night's sleep. Relatable, spiritual and hopeful.

suggestions.title: No Certificates, Still Got Hired
suggestions.hook: बिना सर्टिफिकेट, अमेरिकन कंपनी में जॉब!
suggestions.reason: A tense salary negotiation. He asks for $2000, walks out, gets called back and has an appointment letter within five minutes. It pays off when a prediction from three months earlier comes true. Underdog story with a clear payoff.

suggestions.title: 678 Masjids and a World Record
suggestions.hook: 678 मस्जिदों का क़िबला — गोल्डन बुक रिकॉर्ड
suggestions.reason: A big number and a world record make an easy hook. It ends humbly: the achievement belongs to Maula, not to him. Good for sharing in community groups.

suggestions.title: Your Qibla App Might Be Wrong
suggestions.hook: आपका मोबाइल क़िबला 50° तक गलत हो सकता है!
suggestions.reason: A surprising fact: iron in buildings throws phone compasses off by up to 50°. He then gives the correct method using stars and true north. Useful, easy to share, and people will want to comment.

suggestions.title: Alone Inside the Hujra in Madinah
suggestions.hook: गलती से मैं हुजरा मुबारक के अंदर पहुंच गया
suggestions.reason: A rare, almost unbelievable personal story. He walks through an open door into the sacred hujra and asks a worker where he is standing. Strong emotion and curiosity, ending with the feeling of being close to the Prophet.

suggestions.title: Half-Empty Masjid, Nine Mouths to Feed
suggestions.hook: मस्जिद आधी खाली थी… और घर में 9 लोग
suggestions.reason: Emotional story: the only earner in a family of nine, too shy to ask for help, gets told 'फिक्र ना कर' and says he has slept in peace every night since. The payoff lands hard.

suggestions.title: "Leave Your Govt Job, Go Abroad"
suggestions.hook: मौला ने फरमाया: नौकरी छोड़ दो!
suggestions.reason: Conflict: he has a secure government engineering job and a big family, then gets told to quit and go to America or the Middle East. Viewers want to know what he did.

suggestions.title: The Four-Line Passport Letter
suggestions.hook: न रिश्तेदार, न दोस्त… फिर भी विदेश?
suggestions.reason: Nostalgic underdog moment: no contacts abroad, just four lines on hotel paper dropped in a letter box, and then a job ad in the Times of India.

suggestions.title: Job Interview With Zero Certificates
suggestions.hook: सर्टिफिकेट नहीं… फिर भी इंटरव्यू!
suggestions.reason: Tense back-and-forth over salary with an American company, and he walks out holding his newspaper. Relatable and has drama.

suggestions.title: They Called Him Back
suggestions.hook: कमरे से निकला… और peon ने बुलाया
suggestions.reason: Payoff to the interview: they call him back and give him an appointment letter within five minutes, and the words he heard three months earlier come true.

suggestions.title: Engineer to Ship Captain
suggestions.hook: मुझे जहाज चलाना नहीं आता था
suggestions.reason: Surprising career turn: a land surveyor trains in the Netherlands and becomes the captain of a ship.

suggestions.title: Hand on My Shoulder, Said Three Times
suggestions.hook: मौला पालकी से झुके… कंधे पर हाथ रखा
suggestions.reason: Very emotional, faith-driven moment that ends with the reveal of 678 masjids. Likely to get a lot of shares in the community.

suggestions.title: 678 Masjids: Golden Book Record
suggestions.hook: 678 मस्जिदें — वर्ल्ड रिकॉर्ड!
suggestions.reason: Big number, a world record and a humble answer ('the achievement is not mine'). Easy to share.

suggestions.title: Abu Dhabi Masjid Qibla Was Wrong
suggestions.hook: बनी हुई मस्जिद का क़िबला सही नहीं था
suggestions.reason: Mystery hook: a masjid built with star observations still had its qibla off, and that is what started his lifelong khidmat.

suggestions.title: Are Graves Facing the Qibla?
suggestions.hook: क्या कब्रें क़िबला रुख हैं?
suggestions.reason: A question many people never think about: surveying and planning every kabristan in Bombay by qibla direction.

suggestions.title: Your Phone's Qibla Can Be 50° Off
suggestions.hook: मोबाइल क़िबला ऐप 50° तक गलत!
suggestions.reason: Useful, surprising fact that affects everyday use: steel in buildings bends the magnetic field, and the right way is to observe the stars. Very shareable.

suggestions.title: Worked on Land, Sky and Sea
suggestions.hook: 87 साल… ज़मीन, आसमान और समुंदर
suggestions.reason: An 87-year-old looks back at working in three dimensions, including aerial photogrammetry of borders to track enemy movement. Rare and fascinating.

suggestions.title: Bathed Under the Mizab in Rain
suggestions.hook: 3 डिग्री, बारिश… और मीज़ाब का पानी
suggestions.reason: A rare spiritual experience: an empty tawaf in freezing rain and bathing in water falling from the Mizab of the Kaaba. Wonder-inducing.

suggestions.title: Walked Into the Hujra by Accident
suggestions.hook: दरवाज़ा खुला था… मैं अंदर चला गया
suggestions.reason: Suspense: he wanders through an open door in Madina and asks a worker where he is standing. The ending is gripping.

suggestions.title: Alone in Karbala for an Hour
suggestions.hook: कर्बला के रोज़े में… एक भी आदमी नहीं
suggestions.reason: Wartime Karbala under Saddam, with shelling, and he gets an hour alone at the shrine. Powerful and hard to believe.

suggestions.title: How Social Drinking Became My Escape
suggestions.hook: I didn't drink to party. I drank to hide.
suggestions.reason: A candid confession that builds step by step: first drink, social drinker, 'safe haven', then waiting for any excuse to drink. It ends on a strong line: his family had no idea. Very relatable.

suggestions.title: The Rockstar Who Was Empty Inside
suggestions.hook: Everyone called me the rockstar. Inside, I was hollow.
suggestions.reason: The gap between his public image and how he felt inside hits hard emotionally. The club 'king' felt unloved and less valued than his brothers. People share this kind of vulnerability.

suggestions.title: What Self-Esteem Actually Means
suggestions.hook: Everyone says 'self-esteem.' Almost nobody knows what it means.
suggestions.reason: A simple explanation people can save: self-esteem is your negative emotions weighed against your positive ones, and low self-esteem shows up as a big ego. Good educational hook.

suggestions.title: The Morning My Family Asked: Do You Need Help?
suggestions.hook: My mom woke me up and asked one question.
suggestions.reason: The turning point of his story. Friends call his mom, then his mom and brother wake him up and ask 'Husain, do you need help?' He grabs them and says yes. Very emotional.

suggestions.title: Alcohol Isn't the Problem, It's the Solution
suggestions.hook: 'Alcohol and drugs aren't your problem.'
suggestions.reason: The doctor turns things around: the drinking was his solution, so what's the real problem? It's a surprising idea that gets people commenting and sharing.

suggestions.title: Step Outside Your Own Story
suggestions.hook: Try this before your next big decision.
suggestions.reason: Practical mental tools anyone can use: look at your story from the outside, and set a 'silent hour' to watch your thoughts. Works for viewers well beyond recovery.

suggestions.title: If Someone Judges You, They're Judging Themselves
suggestions.hook: People who judge you are really judging themselves.
suggestions.reason: A quotable line about judgment, honesty and why people with addiction hide. It speaks to anyone who has felt judged, so it could reach a wide audience.

suggestions.title: The Hardest Easy Thing in Recovery
suggestions.hook: The bravest thing you can do? Pick up the phone.
suggestions.reason: First-hand authority ('doctors are great, but I've lived it') plus a clear takeaway: when a 'using thought' hits, calling a friend is the easiest and bravest move. Strong ending.

suggestions.title: Anger Is Just Fear in Disguise
suggestions.hook: Your anger isn't anger. It's fear.
suggestions.reason: Two big insights in one clip: anger comes from fear, and guilt vs shame (guilt is inside you, shame is when others find out). Packed with value and very shareable.

suggestions.title: Why People Relapse: Don't Be Strong
suggestions.hook: Stop trying to be strong.
suggestions.reason: Goes against the usual advice: relapse comes from ego, not surrender, and even the strongest things break, so be anti-fragile instead. Ties back to values like family and sobriety. Strong close for the episode.

suggestions.title: Rejected from Medical, Moved to America
suggestions.hook: મેડિકલમાં એડમિશન ના મળ્યું… તો અમેરિકા ગયો!
suggestions.reason: Classic underdog origin story: failed admission, no money, a ₹200-job reality, then a bold move to the USA in 1962 at age 21. Relatable for any immigrant.

suggestions.title: Brown Skin in Segregated 1960s America
suggestions.hook: 1962: કલરથી માણસ ઓળખાતો હતો
suggestions.reason: Surprising history: segregation-era Oklahoma, a white minister who protected him, and a letter home saying 'this doesn't feel like America'.

suggestions.title: Praying Namaz Standing on His Bed
suggestions.hook: રૂમમેટ મજાક કરતા… પણ નમાજ ના છોડી
suggestions.reason: Very emotional and visual: he prays on his bed because the floor wasn't clean, gets mocked for his brown skin, and keeps going. Faith under pressure is very shareable.

suggestions.title: Moula's 1978 Visit and the Beard Hint
suggestions.hook: મોલાએ ઈશારો કર્યો — દાઢી રાખો
suggestions.reason: A historic first visit to a tiny community, then a personal change after a gentle hint from Moula. A short, warm story about change.

suggestions.title: Small Lamps vs. a Satellite
suggestions.hook: નાના દીવા… કે સેટેલાઈટ?
suggestions.reason: Conflict plus a quotable metaphor: he angers visiting ustads, and someone defends him by saying Moula's arrival lit up the whole jungle. A strong punchline.

suggestions.title: Moula Stayed 13 Days in a Tiny Jamaat
suggestions.hook: મોલા ફક્ત 2 કલાક માટે આવશે… એવું કહ્યું હતું
suggestions.reason: Expectation reversal: others said Moula would stay only two hours, but he stayed 13 days. It ends on a strong before/after (90% beards, kurtas, a masjid built).

suggestions.title: Grandkids Reply in English; COVID Became a Blessing
suggestions.hook: અમે દાવતની જબાનમાં બોલીએ… જવાબ ઇંગ્લિશમાં!
suggestions.reason: A familiar diaspora struggle that every parent and grandparent knows, with an unexpected twist: COVID brought namaz back into every home.

suggestions.title: 'Namaz Saved Me'
suggestions.hook: નમાજે મને બચાવ્યો
suggestions.reason: A strong personal testimony plus practical advice (always stay in wudu and the shaitan stays away). Inspiring and easy to share.

suggestions.title: Wearing a Topi as a Company VP
suggestions.hook: VP છે… તો પણ ઓફિસમાં ટોપી પહેરે
suggestions.reason: Identity and pride: his sons wear topis at senior corporate jobs and his grandkids wear them to school. It shows faith and success can go together.

suggestions.title: Families That Stayed Away Were Ruined
suggestions.hook: જે જમાતથી દૂર રહ્યા… એના બચ્ચા ગયા
suggestions.reason: An 84-year-old's sobering warning plus his father's line, 'Don't let go of the daaman', make an emotional, cautionary clip.

suggestions.title: 'Moula, Come While I'm Still Alive'
suggestions.hook: મોલા, મારી હયાતીમાં પધારી જાવ
suggestions.reason: A tender, emotional request from an elder who built a new home hoping to host Moula again. A strong emotional ending.

suggestions.title: When Majlis Happened in Church Halls
suggestions.hook: મજલીસ… ચર્ચના હોલમાં!
suggestions.reason: A surprising picture of the early community renting church halls, with everyone bringing jajams and cooking pots. It builds gratitude for today's blessings.

suggestions.title: $650 Grave Plot Now Costs $16,000
suggestions.reason: A striking number in the hook and the foresight to buy cemetery land before anyone in the community had died.

suggestions.title: Grave That Reflects the Masjid
suggestions.hook: કબર એવી બનાવો કે મસ્જિદ દેખાય
suggestions.reason: A unique and moving story: Moula told them to bury him in the room where Burhanuddin Moula once ate, inside a glass room that reflects the whole masjid.

suggestions.title: One Piece of Advice for Parents
suggestions.hook: બચ્ચાઓને બચાવવા હોય તો… આ એક વાત
suggestions.reason: A clear, practical takeaway for parents that fits any context: bring kids to majlis even if they cry, and take them to see Moula once a year. Very shareable.

suggestions.title: Grandpa Refused to Sell Playing Cards
suggestions.hook: He threw his whole stock in the river
suggestions.reason: A strong story about choosing principle over profit. The grandfather dumped a whole consignment of playing cards instead of selling them. It has conflict and a clear moral.

suggestions.title: Seven Feet of Ground Is All
suggestions.hook: No one takes more than seven feet of earth
suggestions.reason: A memorable line about wealth and mortality from a grandfather who owned palaces and cars. It's emotional and easy to quote.

suggestions.title: I Ran Out of Books to Read
suggestions.hook: I ran out of books at the library
suggestions.reason: A relatable claim about loving to read: he finished the library and moved on to medical journals. It ends with a clear lesson about building your worldview.

suggestions.title: One Poem, Five Different Meanings
suggestions.hook: Memorization DOES have value. Here's why.
suggestions.reason: It pushes back on the common view that memorization is useless. The same poem means something new at 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50, which makes it reflective and shareable.

suggestions.title: What I Told the Delivery Boy
suggestions.hook: A delivery boy texted me afterward…
suggestions.reason: A heartwarming story about a small moment that mattered. It ends on the idea that success and growth are two different things, a good line for motivational content.

suggestions.title: Lack of Prejudice Is Also Prejudice
suggestions.hook: Even 'no prejudice' is a prejudice
suggestions.reason: A paradox that makes you stop scrolling, followed by practical advice: everyone has something to teach you if you just listen.

suggestions.title: Stop Saying 'Give Back'
suggestions.hook: 'Give back' is the wrong phrase
suggestions.reason: It challenges a common phrase, then backs the point with the science of serotonin, the happiness hormone that comes from giving. Faith and science in one clip.

suggestions.title: The Real Generational Wealth
suggestions.hook: Want generational wealth? Build this.
suggestions.reason: It reframes the popular 'generational wealth' trend in terms of the afterlife and charity that keeps giving after you're gone. Timely and thought-provoking.

suggestions.title: Heaven Is in the Details
suggestions.hook: The devil isn't in the details
suggestions.reason: It flips a well-known saying and uses a grain of sand to show that everything has a purpose. Poetic and easy to quote.

suggestions.title: Sometimes a Smile Is Enough
suggestions.hook: You don't need money to give
suggestions.reason: A warm closing message: giving can be money, an opinion or just listening, and sometimes a smile is enough. Works for any audience.

suggestions.title: Born in Africa, Raised in London
suggestions.hook: Where am I from? It's complicated.
suggestions.reason: An identity hook that works for anyone who grew up across borders. It opens with the struggle to answer 'where do you come from?'

suggestions.title: Translator Couldn't Keep Up Live
suggestions.hook: The translator froze… so he stepped in
suggestions.reason: Clear story with tension and payoff: the official translator can't keep up at a Quran conference, and someone steps in and translates on the spot. Works without any context.

suggestions.title: The Museum Got History Wrong
suggestions.hook: "What you're showing is not what was there"
suggestions.reason: A challenge to an Oxford professor's exhibition, with a quotable ending: 'If you know those facts, you will come to a different conclusion.'

suggestions.title: Who's at Fault When Buildings Fail?
suggestions.hook: When buildings fail, who's to blame?
suggestions.reason: A peek into forensic engineering on insurance claims. The question hook gets curiosity going, and the clip ends on a lesson that stuck with him.

suggestions.title: Desert Engineering: 500m Uphill
suggestions.hook: 2.5 km of pipe, 500 m straight up
suggestions.reason: Concrete numbers and a problem-and-solution arc (pump water 500 m up and cut it down to one station). Engineering content like this does well on Shorts.

suggestions.title: Experts Said 7 Years. It Lasted 36
suggestions.hook: They said 7 years max. It's been 36.
suggestions.reason: A prediction proven wrong decades later. The '7 years vs 36 years' contrast is a strong hook and the clip ends on a clean win.

suggestions.title: A 'Short Period' That Lasted 16 Years
suggestions.hook: My 'short stay' lasted 16 years
suggestions.reason: An ironic, funny line about life plans that people relate to. It sits on top of a story about moving countries.

suggestions.title: Why Big-Picture Work Beats Routine
suggestions.hook: Doing the same thing daily gets boring
suggestions.reason: Career advice anyone can relate to: a small role at a big company versus seeing the whole picture abroad. Works as a standalone clip and is easy to share.

suggestions.title: Learned Arabic in Yemen, Not Saudi
suggestions.hook: In Saudi, you needed Turkish, not Arabic
suggestions.reason: A surprising, counterintuitive fact about expat life in 1980s Jeddah. It's light and easy to share.

suggestions.title: When You Speak Too Many Languages
suggestions.hook: I start in Arabic… and switch to English
suggestions.reason: A humble, relatable moment for multilingual and diaspora viewers about languages blending together after living in many countries.

clips.title: Schools Teach Kids to Fear Mistakes
clips.hook: We're educating kids OUT of creativity

agentHistory.prompt: The progress bar is not visible in the preview. Fix it and verify it shows up.
agentHistory.summary:
The progress bar was working the whole time. At 0 seconds it's zero width, and the preview opens paused at 0, so there was nothing to see until you pressed play or scrubbed. Snapshots confirm the bar now shows: at 0s only a faint grey track is visible, at 30s the yellow is about half full, and at 58s it's almost all the way across. Lint shows 0 errors and 0 warnings.

I didn't make a code change this time. While I was checking, `index.html` was edited outside this session: it now has a faint grey track behind the yellow fill, so the bar's position shows even at the start. It was also made a bi

agentHistory.prompt: none of the speakers are in frame
agentHistory.summary:
